mentions.name: Public Knowledge Base
mentions.description: This project documents the author's knowledge as a public knowledge base, currently holding notes on Python and Git. It weighs publishing approaches such as Obsidian Sync / Publish / Markdown against an open-source knowledge-base website built with VSCodium, Markdown, FOAM, MkDocs, and RClone; no satisfying solution has been found yet.
mentions.problem: The author hasn't found a knowledge-base publishing solution they are happy with yet.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Documenting my Knowledge as "Public Knowledge Base"
- https://codeberg.org/jro/Knowledge - Here are my notes on Python, Git
- I'm bouncing between Obsidian Sync / Publish / Markdown (currently easiest way), and some sort of open-source knowledge base website (VSCodium + Markdown + FOAM + MkDocs + RClone). I haven't found a solution I'm happy with yet...
